capability_statement: Operators can see whether provider-read feedback accepted, blocked, reopened, deferred, or needs review directly in Mission Control.
before_state: The operator had to open provider integration, observation replay, and external operator feedback artifacts and infer the decision state manually.
after_state: Mission Control exposes the decision state, feedback route, summary, next action, evidence refs, and not-proven boundary in one projection.
scenario: After a provider observation replay receives operator feedback, the release operator checks Mission Control to decide whether the chain is accepted or must reopen product work.
five_minute_demo: Run visibility-export, open mission-control.json, and inspect provider_read_decision_replay_projection.latest_decision_state and latest_next_action.
time_saved_or_work_reduced: Removes manual reconstruction across three provider-read artifacts for routine go/no-go inspection.
cognitive_load_removed: The operator no longer needs to remember how external feedback routes map to accepted, blocked, reopened, deferred, or needs-review states.

capability_matrix.before: No first-class Mission Control decision state for provider-read feedback.
capability_matrix.after: Decision state and next action are visible in Mission Control.
capability_matrix.user_value: Provider-read evidence can be operated as a decision, not a pile of artifacts.

not_proven: This product value evidence is self-hosting evidence and does not prove broad third-party adoption or market value.
